Definition: to seven oneself, i.e. swear (as if by repeating a declaration seven times)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to swear, adjure; 1a) (Qal) sworn (participle); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to swear, take an oath; 1b2) to swear (of Jehovah by Himself); 1b3) to curse; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to take an oath; 1c2) to adjure
